Generated code still has an on-call. A 600 line retry handler passes review, then double-charges 31 customers four months later, and the engineer paged finds no record of why the backoff is 40 seconds. It shipped the answer without the reasoning.

Name an owner, write a two sentence why-note in the PR, read the failure paths. Accepting code is signing for it.
